name: Stock-LSTM-Forecasting
description: Predict stock prices using LSTM networks in PyTorch. This project covers data preprocessing, sliding window creation, model training with early stopping, and evaluation with RMSE/MAE/MAPE. Includes visualizations of training loss, predicted vs actual prices, and short-horizon forecasts.

name: Image-Captioning-CNN-LSTM
description: An end-to-end image captioning project using a CNN encoder (ResNet-50) and LSTM decoder in PyTorch. Includes vocabulary building, preprocessing, training with BLEU evaluation, and inference. Generates natural language captions for images with saved metrics, model checkpoints, and visualization outputs.
